findings.explanation: high confidence. In sentence [p2-0], the authors claim that 'the inverse of IRK matrix and BIM matrix is exactly $W_n^T$ if $c_i$ ($1 \leq i \leq n$) are the zeros of the Legendre polynomials and $c_i = i$ ($1 \leq i \leq n$), respectively.' However, as shown in (2.19) and [p7-11], when $c_i = i$, $C_n = D_n$, so the submatrix is $W_n^T = V_n D_n V_n^{-1} D_n^{-1}$. The inverse of the BIM matrix, denoted by $N$ in [p7-11], is given by $N = D_n (V_n D_n V_n^{-1} D_n^{-1}) D_n^{-1} + D_n^{-1} = D_n W_n^T D_n^{-1} + D_n^{-1}$, which is not equal to $W_n^T$. Witness: N = D_n W_n^T D_n^{-1} + D_n^{-1}
